Rules.blurb: Proposals to add, drop or reword a rule. Link the rule's anchor in the docs; the change itself is a pull request that touches docs/rules.md, rules.py, engine.js and the parity test together.

Bugs.blurb: Something the studio, the compiler or the checker got wrong. Attach the qccd.studio artifact the page exports; a reproducible one becomes an issue.

Features.blurb: What the platform should do next.
